Security

Controls we operate

These are the controls that are live today. We publish what we run because honesty here is a differentiator — no regional competitor can publish this page.

Dedicated database per customer

A dedicated PostgreSQL database per customer — not a shared table with a tenant column. Your data is never in the same database as another customer's.

Immutable ledger

Entries are reversed, never edited. Every change creates a new entry with a timestamp and user reference. The audit trail is the record.

Encrypted backups

Encrypted daily backups of every database. Backups are stored in a separate region and tested quarterly.

Restore drills

Restore drills that are run and recorded, not assumed. We test the backups quarterly and document the results.

Central policy engine

Permissions enforced server-side, not just hidden in the UI. A central policy engine means no client-side bypass is possible.

Document retention

Ten-year document retention, with QR verification on issued documents. Every document you issue carries a verifiable QR code.

Certification roadmap

Certification roadmap: SOC 2 Type II in 2027.
